brief.notes: Family-sized electric SUV. Primary target: parents with young children who need space and safety. Secondary, lower-priority target: single tech-forward professionals drawn to the EV/green-tech angle rather than the family use-case.

labels.labeler_note: Electric vehicle (the green-tech/single-professional angle) is kept to acceptable only, not must_include, since the brief names it explicitly as the lower-priority secondary audience.
